kpis.description_fr: Ventes segment Commercial & Industrial (gros clients industriels, militaire, aviation). Plus défensif vs Tools Group dépendant des techniciens.
kpis.description_en: Commercial & Industrial Group sales (large industrial, military, aviation). More defensive vs Tools Group dependent on technicians.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Tools Group (van franchise, vente directe aux techniciens). Cœur historique de la marque. Sensible au cycle achat tech / financement consommateur.
kpis.description_en: Tools Group sales (van franchise, direct sales to technicians). Brand historical core. Sensitive to tech purchase cycle / consumer financing.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Repair Systems & Information (diagnostic, software ateliers OEM). Segment à plus forte marge, croissance subscription diagnostics.
kpis.description_en: Repair Systems & Information sales (diagnostics, OEM shop software). Higher-margin segment, diagnostics subscription growth.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus Snap-on Financial Services (financement extended-credit techniciens, contrats). Activité bancaire captive très rentable, soutien aux ventes Tools Group.
kpis.description_en: Snap-on Financial Services revenue (technician extended credit, contracts). Captive financing, very profitable, supports Tools Group sales.

kpis_story.description_fr: Cycle outils mécaniciens automobile en creux 2024 (financement franchisees serré, mécanos prudents). Reprise attendue 2025 avec baisse taux Fed.
kpis_story.description_en: Auto mechanic tool cycle bottom 2024 (tight franchisee financing, cautious mechanics). Recovery expected 2025 with Fed rate cuts.

_notes: Snap-on : KPIs alignés sur les 4 segments reporting (C&I, Tools Group, RS&I, Financial Services). Tools Group sous pression 2023-2024 (cycle tech).
